LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_MiliraBloodline.label: [Raven] Angel Bloodline (Lesser)
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_MiliraBloodline.description:
An angel bloodline branch from the Milira race. The bearer's body becomes lighter, and reflexes become much more suited to ranged combat.

Effects:
- Move speed +1.0 cells/sec
- Aim time x90%
